jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Our headquarters and most of our team are based in Ottawa. For employees located in Ottawa,

this role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately four days per week

in the office at our headquarters. We also welcome remote candidates from anywhere in Canada

About The Team

The Vice President, Finance Operations & Transformation is a senior finance executive responsible for leading and scaling a modern finance operations team for a public company.

This leader owns the operational backbone of Finance: accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll operations, procurement, deal desk governance, customer contracting, and finance operations transformation.

The mandate is not simply to run today’s processes; it is to redesign and modernize them so the company can scale efficiently, improve the employee and customer experience, strengthen financial discipline, and operate with greater speed, consistency, automation, and insight.

The successful candidate will bring a transformation mindset and a strong operating cadence. They will be equally comfortable improving day-to-day execution, creating enterprise-wide standards, partnering with Sales and Legal on complex commercial transactions, working with IT on systems and workflow automation, and leading change across the finance organization.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

Lead global finance operations across accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll operations, procurement, customer contracting and deal desk governance.
Ensure the efficient and accurate processing of all financial transactions, application of internal controls, and compliance with company policies and procedures.
Lead the team and serve as a global advisor on deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial terms to optimize revenue outcomes. Provide strategic insights into deal dependencies, risks, and opportunities to support global planning and execution.
Lead the transformation of finance operations by improving processes, leveraging technology, and introducing automation and AI where they create business value.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or eliminate manual processes across financial operations.
Grow teams, develop leaders across the portfolio, and create an environment that supports collaboration, operational excellence, and modern enterprise thinking

What we are looking for

15 years of progressive financial leadership experience.
Significant experience with finance operations, finance transformation, procurement operations, or related environments.
Knowledge of industry best practices and emerging trends in finance transformation.
Proven ability to modernize processes through standardization, automation, analytics, AI-enabled tools, and operating model redesign.
Strong leadership skills to provide vision and support to the Finance team, mentor individuals, and develop high-performing talent.

#VP

#DF-LI1

Work With Impact:
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Controllership & Operations Transformation
jobs.description:
Description

The Experience

As the Senior Director within the Salesforce Controllership group, you will be the strategic owner of our Finance system architecture, data flow, and enhancement roadmap. It is a critical leadership position requiring you to bridge the gap between complex accounting requirements and technical execution. You will oversee initiatives, drive the evolution of our Workday Cloud ERP ecosystem, and ensure AI is at the forefront of our financial automation strategy. With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, our team builds intelligent systems that automate repetitive subledger flows, elevate strategic accounting tasks, and power better financial decision-making at scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Strategic Record to Report (R2R) Leadership: Direct and oversee comprehensive R2R initiatives involving complex data streams across both revenue and non-revenue business functions.
Systems: Act as the business sponsor for the finance technology stack, deploying ERP enhancements, automation, and reporting infrastructure to reduce manual touchpoints.
Processes: Redesign end-to-end R2R cycles (close, consolidation, statutory reporting) to drive operational efficiency and shorten time-to-insight.
People: Serve as the primary change agent, guiding cross-functional teams through transition periods, breaking down silos between technical and accounting teams, and transforming workforce capabilities to support a modern digital finance organization.

ERP System Ownership: Serve as the primary business owner for the accounting ERP system. Define the strategic vision for system architecture, data integrity, and operational scale.
IT Partnership & Issue Resolution: Partner directly with IT to manage, prioritize, and resolve critical ERP production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to accounting operations.
AI & Automation Roadmap: Champion and lead initiatives to continuously automate and enhance the ERP system, actively identifying and integrating AI-driven solutions to modernize accounting workflows.
Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a central strategic partner. Drive alignment, influence decision-making, and secure buy-in from senior stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Engineering, and Operations.
AI & Automation Enablement: Identify and deploy with finance transformations high-impact AI/agent use cases to scale automated, data-driven operations across Controllership.
Lead Global Controllership Alignment: Serve as a central integration point to ensure that as we scale, our initiatives are aligned across our Global Process Owners (GPOs), cross-functional partners, and technology teams.
Drive Holistic Stakeholders Engagement: Facilitate alignment across diverse groups (Tax, Treasury, Legal, M&A) to ensure that Controllership initiatives consider the full financial picture and regulatory landscape.
Strategic Decision Support: Lead key strategic projects within the Global Accounting organization, specifically identifying decision bottlenecks and presenting clear facts to the appropriate stakeholders to facilitate resolution.
Technology & Business Liaison: Serve as a key bridge between the Accounting function and the Digital Enterprise Transformation (DET) team. You will help articulate clear business facts, define requirements, and support critical design decisions to ensure our systems support our accounting needs.
Executive Communication & Storytelling: Transform complex project updates and accounting data into clear, compelling narratives. You will act as the content creator for executive presentation

You're Our Person If...

12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, financial systems, or finance transformation, with a strong background in R2R processes.
Technical Acumen - Deep expertise in enterprise-level ERP systems and accounting data architecture.
Strategic Execution - Proven ability to act as a strategic driver rather than a task manager, with a track record of translating complex financial needs into scalable system solutions.
Stakeholder Influence - Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional technical and non-technical stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
Forward-Thinking - Demonstrated passion for exploring and implementing emerging technologies, specifically AI and machine learning, within the finance and accounting domain.
Demonstrated track record of successfully designing and implementing process improvements that reduced manual effort and improved accuracy
BA/BS degree is required in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related subject area or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the Core Competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.
Expertise in US GAAP, IFRS and local statutory requirements; Robust experience with SOX audit framework
You bring exceptional problem-solving skills using structured frameworks to dissect complex operational failures and present technical roadmaps to finance leadership.

Even Better If...

You have a combination of prior experience in management or technology consulting focused on transformation and have hands-on Finance Operations experience.
System experience - Workday experience preferred
You have first-hand experience driving AI transformation initiatives, specifically implementing agentic automation and intelligent workflows within Finance.

This role is hybrid and goes into the office 3 days per week.

jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Our nationally recognized client located in Downtown Ottawa is looking for a Bilingual Director of Finance & Administration to join their established organization on a full-time, permanent basis.

This organization fosters professional growth and leadership while offering a competitive compensation package, all within a supportive, collaborative work culture.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Coordination and preparation of budget and financial forecasts, institute and maintain planning and control procedures and analyze report variances
Financial reporting and production of financial statements- prepare monthly, quarterly and annual reports while ensuring accuracy
Management of General Ledger and related accounting duties
Preparing Month and Year End closing, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and proper documentation
Oversee processing of payroll, remittances, union dues, & WSIB
Submission of tax remittances
Liaising with auditors, take an active role in internal and external Audit, providing required reporting
Provide representation and work directly with the union on all matters
Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing insight on financial matters
Ensuring compliance as well as implementation of process improvements, monitoring for accurate and successful execution
Oversee and provide support to accounting and administration team
Participate in other active projects and ad hoc reporting as needed
Provide contributions and recommendations regarding financial and operational aspects of the organization, communicating with Senior Management on strategic initiatives

About You

The successful candidate will have the following:

Fluently Bilingual in both official languages (English, French)
CPA Designation- Active in Good Standing
5+ years of experience in Accounting & Finance in a Senior role
3+ years of previous leadership experience of a team of 4+ staff
Previous experience with Unionized environments a strong asset
Advanced level Microsoft Excel
Strong oral, written, and communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills
Highly organized, strong attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal skills, self-starter, collaborative

About the Job

The salary band for this role is $120,000 to $130,000 depending on relevant previous experience.

How To Apply

Please apply by clicking the “Apply Now” button below and follow the instructions to submit your résumé. You can also apply by submitting your résumé directly to sgomi@lrostaffing.com. If you are already registered with us, please contact your Senior Recruiter. Please quote job 19404

jobs.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
jobs.description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?
The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Work

Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives.

The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations.

In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence.

The Core Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

Support the development and execution of the annual business strategy, operating plan, and growth priorities for the Reverse Mortgage business.
Own business performance management, including KPI development, executive dashboards, forecasting, and financial modeling.
Drive strategic business initiatives and investment decisions through business cases, market analysis, profitability assessments and ongoing performance reporting. Lead the execution of initiatives as needed.
Key Metrics: Achievement of annual volume, revenue, and profitability targets, Strategic initiative delivery (% completed on time and on budget), KPI and reporting accuracy/timeliness

Risk Management & Governance

Own first-line risk management activities across credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, and reputational risk.
Act as the primary liaison between the business and Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and other partners.
Lead program development activities such as a the corporate RCM program, risk assessments, issue remediation, governance activities, and committee submissions while ensuring compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Perform testing of business controls as needed.
Key Metrics: Number and severity of audit, compliance, or regulatory findings, completion of remediation actions within agreed timelines, business performance against approved risk appetite metrics.

Credit Risk, Portfolio Analytics & Model Governance

Oversee LTV model governance, portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and scenario analysis to support risk management and strategic decision-making.
Partner with Credit Risk and Finance teams to monitor portfolio performance, concentration risks, and emerging trends.
Lead development and reporting of portfolio, risk, and capital metrics for executive and Board audiences.
Key Metrics: Portfolio delinquency and loss performance versus plan, timeliness and accuracy of stress testing and scenario analysis, LTV model governance and validation compliance.

Executive, Board & Regulatory Reporting

Lead preparation of Board, Executive Committee, ERMC, and regulatory reporting packages.
Develop clear, data-driven insights and recommendations supporting strategic and risk-related decision-making.
Ensure reporting effectively communicates business performance, emerging risks, and mitigation actions.
Key Metrics: On-time delivery of Board and committee materials, stakeholder satisfaction with reporting quality and insights, number of material reporting errors or revisions.

Business Enablement & Transformation

Lead cross-functional business transformation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance scale, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Establish governance frameworks to prioritize, monitor, and measure strategic project delivery.
Partner across Technology, Operations, Product, and Finance to remove barriers and accelerate execution. Identify and accelerate opportunities to leverage AI through the risk and all business functions.
Key Metrics: Benefits realized from business initiatives, project delivery on time and within budget.

New Product Development & Innovation

Lead strategic evaluation, business case development, and governance for new products and product enhancements.
Coordinate cross-functional assessments involving Risk, Finance, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology.
Ensure new products meet profitability, customer, risk, and regulatory objectives.
Key Metrics: New product launches delivered on time, business case outcomes versus forecast, product profitability and adoption rates

People Leadership

Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team responsible for strategy, risk, analytics, and business operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Build organizational capability in strategic planning, governance, data analytics, and risk management.
Key Metrics: Employee engagement scores, achievement of team performance objectives.

Let's Talk About You

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, risk management, business management, finance, consulting, or related leadership roles within financial services.
Ideally has a mix of Consulting and financial industry experience.
Deep understanding of credit risk, operational risk, compliance risk, governance frameworks, and financial services regulatory environments.
Experience preparing Executive Committee, Board, and Risk Committee materials.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development experience.
Experience leading strategic planning and enterprise transformation initiatives.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams.
Advanced proficiency in data analysis, KPI development, dashboard creation, and performance management.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]

💰 Competitive discretionary bonus

✨ Market leading RRSP match program

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan

👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one

🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days

🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues

🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program

💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience

The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON
.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.

We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.

As part of our recruitment process, EQ uses AI to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position. All AI-enabled outputs are reviewed and validated by our talent team. All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.

EQB Inc. (TSX: EQB) is the parent company of Equitable Bank, the country's seventh-largest Schedule I bank by assets, which operates EQ Bank, Canada's Challenger Bank™. EQB Inc. serves nearly 4 million Canadians and manages approximately $150 billion in combined assets under management and administration.

To learn more, visit eqb.investorroom.com and eqbank.ca.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Controllership & Operations Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Experience

As the Senior Director within the Salesforce Controllership group, you will be the strategic owner of our Finance system architecture, data flow, and enhancement roadmap. It is a critical leadership position requiring you to bridge the gap between complex accounting requirements and technical execution. You will oversee initiatives, drive the evolution of our Workday Cloud ERP ecosystem, and ensure AI is at the forefront of our financial automation strategy. With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, our team builds intelligent systems that automate repetitive subledger flows, elevate strategic accounting tasks, and power better financial decision-making at scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Strategic Record to Report (R2R) Leadership: Direct and oversee comprehensive R2R initiatives involving complex data streams across both revenue and non-revenue business functions.
Systems: Act as the business sponsor for the finance technology stack, deploying ERP enhancements, automation, and reporting infrastructure to reduce manual touchpoints.
Processes: Redesign end-to-end R2R cycles (close, consolidation, statutory reporting) to drive operational efficiency and shorten time-to-insight.
People: Serve as the primary change agent, guiding cross-functional teams through transition periods, breaking down silos between technical and accounting teams, and transforming workforce capabilities to support a modern digital finance organization.

ERP System Ownership: Serve as the primary business owner for the accounting ERP system. Define the strategic vision for system architecture, data integrity, and operational scale.
IT Partnership & Issue Resolution: Partner directly with IT to manage, prioritize, and resolve critical ERP production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to accounting operations.
AI & Automation Roadmap: Champion and lead initiatives to continuously automate and enhance the ERP system, actively identifying and integrating AI-driven solutions to modernize accounting workflows.
Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a central strategic partner. Drive alignment, influence decision-making, and secure buy-in from senior stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Engineering, and Operations.
AI & Automation Enablement: Identify and deploy with finance transformations high-impact AI/agent use cases to scale automated, data-driven operations across Controllership.
Lead Global Controllership Alignment: Serve as a central integration point to ensure that as we scale, our initiatives are aligned across our Global Process Owners (GPOs), cross-functional partners, and technology teams.
Drive Holistic Stakeholders Engagement: Facilitate alignment across diverse groups (Tax, Treasury, Legal, M&A) to ensure that Controllership initiatives consider the full financial picture and regulatory landscape.
Strategic Decision Support: Lead key strategic projects within the Global Accounting organization, specifically identifying decision bottlenecks and presenting clear facts to the appropriate stakeholders to facilitate resolution.
Technology & Business Liaison: Serve as a key bridge between the Accounting function and the Digital Enterprise Transformation (DET) team. You will help articulate clear business facts, define requirements, and support critical design decisions to ensure our systems support our accounting needs.
Executive Communication & Storytelling: Transform complex project updates and accounting data into clear, compelling narratives. You will act as the content creator for executive presentation

You're Our Person If...

12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, financial systems, or finance transformation, with a strong background in R2R processes.
Technical Acumen - Deep expertise in enterprise-level ERP systems and accounting data architecture.
Strategic Execution - Proven ability to act as a strategic driver rather than a task manager, with a track record of translating complex financial needs into scalable system solutions.
Stakeholder Influence - Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional technical and non-technical stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
Forward-Thinking - Demonstrated passion for exploring and implementing emerging technologies, specifically AI and machine learning, within the finance and accounting domain.
Demonstrated track record of successfully designing and implementing process improvements that reduced manual effort and improved accuracy
BA/BS degree is required in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related subject area or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the Core Competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.
Expertise in US GAAP, IFRS and local statutory requirements; Robust experience with SOX audit framework
You bring exceptional problem-solving skills using structured frameworks to dissect complex operational failures and present technical roadmaps to finance leadership.

Even Better If...

You have a combination of prior experience in management or technology consulting focused on transformation and have hands-on Finance Operations experience.
System experience - Workday experience preferred
You have first-hand experience driving AI transformation initiatives, specifically implementing agentic automation and intelligent workflows within Finance.

This role is hybrid and goes into the office 3 days per week.

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Director of Finance & Administration - Permanent - 19404
new_jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Our nationally recognized client located in Downtown Ottawa is looking for a Bilingual Director of Finance & Administration to join their established organization on a full-time, permanent basis.

This organization fosters professional growth and leadership while offering a competitive compensation package, all within a supportive, collaborative work culture.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Coordination and preparation of budget and financial forecasts, institute and maintain planning and control procedures and analyze report variances
Financial reporting and production of financial statements- prepare monthly, quarterly and annual reports while ensuring accuracy
Management of General Ledger and related accounting duties
Preparing Month and Year End closing, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and proper documentation
Oversee processing of payroll, remittances, union dues, & WSIB
Submission of tax remittances
Liaising with auditors, take an active role in internal and external Audit, providing required reporting
Provide representation and work directly with the union on all matters
Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing insight on financial matters
Ensuring compliance as well as implementation of process improvements, monitoring for accurate and successful execution
Oversee and provide support to accounting and administration team
Participate in other active projects and ad hoc reporting as needed
Provide contributions and recommendations regarding financial and operational aspects of the organization, communicating with Senior Management on strategic initiatives

About You

The successful candidate will have the following:

Fluently Bilingual in both official languages (English, French)
CPA Designation- Active in Good Standing
5+ years of experience in Accounting & Finance in a Senior role
3+ years of previous leadership experience of a team of 4+ staff
Previous experience with Unionized environments a strong asset
Advanced level Microsoft Excel
Strong oral, written, and communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills
Highly organized, strong attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal skills, self-starter, collaborative

About the Job

The salary band for this role is $120,000 to $130,000 depending on relevant previous experience.

How To Apply

Please apply by clicking the “Apply Now” button below and follow the instructions to submit your résumé. You can also apply by submitting your résumé directly to sgomi@lrostaffing.com. If you are already registered with us, please contact your Senior Recruiter. Please quote job 19404
.

LRO Staffing values fairness, confidentiality, and human judgment in every stage of our hiring process. We do not use automated or AI-driven screening tools to assess applications. Each submission is reviewed by an experienced recruiter to ensure a thoughtful and equitable evaluation of every candidate.

Thank you for your interest in this role. One of our Recruiters will be in touch with you if your profile meets the requirements for the role and the expectations of our clients. Please note that all candidates must be permitted to work in Canada to be considered for this opportunity.

new_jobs.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
new_jobs.description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?
The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Work

Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives.

The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations.

In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence.

The Core Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

Support the development and execution of the annual business strategy, operating plan, and growth priorities for the Reverse Mortgage business.
Own business performance management, including KPI development, executive dashboards, forecasting, and financial modeling.
Drive strategic business initiatives and investment decisions through business cases, market analysis, profitability assessments and ongoing performance reporting. Lead the execution of initiatives as needed.
Key Metrics: Achievement of annual volume, revenue, and profitability targets, Strategic initiative delivery (% completed on time and on budget), KPI and reporting accuracy/timeliness

Risk Management & Governance

Own first-line risk management activities across credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, and reputational risk.
Act as the primary liaison between the business and Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and other partners.
Lead program development activities such as a the corporate RCM program, risk assessments, issue remediation, governance activities, and committee submissions while ensuring compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Perform testing of business controls as needed.
Key Metrics: Number and severity of audit, compliance, or regulatory findings, completion of remediation actions within agreed timelines, business performance against approved risk appetite metrics.

Credit Risk, Portfolio Analytics & Model Governance

Oversee LTV model governance, portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and scenario analysis to support risk management and strategic decision-making.
Partner with Credit Risk and Finance teams to monitor portfolio performance, concentration risks, and emerging trends.
Lead development and reporting of portfolio, risk, and capital metrics for executive and Board audiences.
Key Metrics: Portfolio delinquency and loss performance versus plan, timeliness and accuracy of stress testing and scenario analysis, LTV model governance and validation compliance.

Executive, Board & Regulatory Reporting

Lead preparation of Board, Executive Committee, ERMC, and regulatory reporting packages.
Develop clear, data-driven insights and recommendations supporting strategic and risk-related decision-making.
Ensure reporting effectively communicates business performance, emerging risks, and mitigation actions.
Key Metrics: On-time delivery of Board and committee materials, stakeholder satisfaction with reporting quality and insights, number of material reporting errors or revisions.

Business Enablement & Transformation

Lead cross-functional business transformation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance scale, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Establish governance frameworks to prioritize, monitor, and measure strategic project delivery.
Partner across Technology, Operations, Product, and Finance to remove barriers and accelerate execution. Identify and accelerate opportunities to leverage AI through the risk and all business functions.
Key Metrics: Benefits realized from business initiatives, project delivery on time and within budget.

New Product Development & Innovation

Lead strategic evaluation, business case development, and governance for new products and product enhancements.
Coordinate cross-functional assessments involving Risk, Finance, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology.
Ensure new products meet profitability, customer, risk, and regulatory objectives.
Key Metrics: New product launches delivered on time, business case outcomes versus forecast, product profitability and adoption rates

People Leadership

Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team responsible for strategy, risk, analytics, and business operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Build organizational capability in strategic planning, governance, data analytics, and risk management.
Key Metrics: Employee engagement scores, achievement of team performance objectives.

Let's Talk About You

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, risk management, business management, finance, consulting, or related leadership roles within financial services.
Ideally has a mix of Consulting and financial industry experience.
Deep understanding of credit risk, operational risk, compliance risk, governance frameworks, and financial services regulatory environments.
Experience preparing Executive Committee, Board, and Risk Committee materials.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development experience.
Experience leading strategic planning and enterprise transformation initiatives.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams.
Advanced proficiency in data analysis, KPI development, dashboard creation, and performance management.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]

💰 Competitive discretionary bonus

✨ Market leading RRSP match program

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan

👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one

🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days

🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues

🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program

💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience

The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON
.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.

We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.

As part of our recruitment process, EQ uses AI to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position. All AI-enabled outputs are reviewed and validated by our talent team. All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.

EQB Inc. (TSX: EQB) is the parent company of Equitable Bank, the country's seventh-largest Schedule I bank by assets, which operates EQ Bank, Canada's Challenger Bank™. EQB Inc. serves nearly 4 million Canadians and manages approximately $150 billion in combined assets under management and administration.

To learn more, visit eqb.investorroom.com and eqbank.ca.
